hook: In 1586, a pregnant mother was brutally crushed to death in York.

sections.voiceover: In 1586, a pregnant mother was brutally crushed to death in York.
sections.visual_cue: Historical illustration of 16th-century York with dramatic shadows and tense atmosphere.
sections.sfx_cue: Heavy wooden thud followed by low ambient drone

sections.voiceover: Authorities didn't spare Margaret Clitherow after accusing her of harbouring Catholic priests in York. She refused to enter a plea while pregnant with her 4th child. What did Guy Fawkes see in York?
sections.visual_cue: Close-up of a handwritten 1586 trial record document transition to a map of York.

sections.voiceover: But she wouldn't testify, so they slowly crushed her to death on Lady Day in 1586.
sections.visual_cue: Cinematic pan across a crowd of onlookers in historic attire gathered in a cobblestone square.
sections.sfx_cue: Subtle crowd murmur and wind swell

sections.voiceover: Historians theorise Guy Fawkes witnessed this 1586 execution in York. Christopher Wright and John Wright also knew her tragic story. This brutal act shaped conspirators before the 1605 gunpowder plot.
sections.visual_cue: Historical portraits of Guy Fawkes alongside Christopher Wright and John Wright with gunpowder plot documents.

sections.voiceover: Don't forget how Clitherow's 1586 death in York influenced the 1605 gunpowder plot.
sections.visual_cue: Slow zoom out on the historic city walls of York under a dusk sky.
sections.sfx_cue: Deep ringing bell chime fading out
